title: Provider Live Validation Evidence
description: Schema for post-cloud provider live validation evidence artifacts

cloud_endpoint.description: Public cloud endpoint URL used for validation

provider_account_id.description: Provider account identifier (e.g., Stripe acct_..., GitHub owner/repo)

validator.description: Person or system that performed validation

platform_version.description: Commit SHA or version tag of the platform under test

webhook_received.description: Was the webhook event received by the platform?

delivery_status.description: Platform delivery status for the event

event_type_matched.description: Did the event type match the triggered event?

delivery_latency_ms.description: Milliseconds between event trigger and delivery receipt

evidence_ref.description: Path to the delivery log evidence artifact

signature_header_present.description: Was the provider-specific signature header present?

platform_verification_valid.description: Did the platform report valid signature?

manual_verification_matches.description: Did manual re-verification match platform result?

signature_header_name.description: Name of the signature header (e.g., Stripe-Signature)

evidence_ref.description: Path to the validation evidence artifact
Path to the negative test evidence artifact

contains_live_credentials.description: Does this evidence contain live credentials?

claims_live_validated_all_providers.description: Does this evidence claim 'live validated' for all providers?

claims_ga_or_public_launch_go.description: Does this evidence claim GA or public launch GO?

claims_free_is_evaluation_only.description: Does this evidence claim 'Free is evaluation-only'?

artifact_list.description: List of all evidence artifact files

notes.description: Free-form notes about the validation run
